item.title: Happy Onam 2026: Best wishes, quotes & messages for family and friends
item.summary: Onam is a vibrant harvest festival celebrated with immense fervor in Kerala. This occasion sees the sharing of warm wishes and heartfelt messages, promoting joy and abundance among family and friends. Traditional practices such as crafting intricate pookalams and relishing the elaborate sadya form the heart of the festivities. Onam is a time when families come together to create cherished memories while deepening their connections.
